assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Triangle ABC with its circumcircle (centre O) and incircle (centre I, radius IF to the foot F on AB). The line AI meets the circumcircle again at M below BC, and segment MB is drawn; the red dashed diameter XY passes through O and I.

difficulty_rationale: Needs the auxiliary point M on the circumcircle, the equal lengths MB = MI, and the power of the point I, combined with two trigonometric length formulas.
